reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact finding reported in P1 (and supported by P3) that increasing sintering temperature promotes a more complete 3D copper network, thereby increasing thermal conductivity, without adding any new material, regime, mechanism, or combination of sources. The proposed experiment is a straightforward validation of this already-reported result.
copied_elements: Increasing sintering temperature to promote copper network formation
Mechanism: enhanced copper slip and diffusion forming a 3D network
Predicted outcome: higher thermal conductivity due to better copper network
Material system: chemically plated W-20Cu composite
Processing method: 3D printing assisted injection molding and sintering
